title: Comfort Colors Pickleball Gigi Shirt, Sweet as Pie Sneaky at the Net, Funny Gift for Gigi from Grandkids
description:
Sweet as pie off the court and sneaky at the net. A warm, funny pickleball shirt for the Gigi everyone is scared to play against.

Who it's for:
- A Gigi who plays pickleball every week
- Grandkids and adult children looking for a gift she will actually wear
- Mother's Day, birthday and Christmas shopping

About the design:
Arched 'PICKLEBALL' over a big 'GIGI', with two paddles and a ball, and the line 'Sweet as pie, sneaky at the net'.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Pickleball Gigi design with two paddles and the line Sweet as pie, sneaky at the net on a light pink tee.
